description: Rolling history of FlexForce Business Administration (BA) Grid backend/API response-timing runs (measure-ba-grid-api.mjs: BA Grid list x2 variants, create/update/delete cycle) — parallel to results/run-history-api.json (License Management), but for the BA module. Append one entry per completed, trustworthy run.

baseline.note: First full-coverage (6/6 roles) BA Grid timing run, taken before any BA Grid performance work. Use this as the 'before' side of any future before/after comparison — re-run measure-ba-grid-api.mjs (or ROLE_FILTER=<role> node measure-ba-grid-api.mjs <label>) and diff each role's business-step ms against the table below.

BA.note: not applicable — BA role is rejected with 400 BA.Unauthorized by design

runs.summary: First trustworthy run after fixing a create-response-parsing bug (initial smoke test left orphan BA rows 386/387, manually cleaned up). Root/Admin: grid list ~170-570ms, create ~220-230ms, update ~180-190ms, delete ~200-280ms — all well within normal range. BA role: grid and create both return 400 BA.Unauthorized as expected (BA members are not authorized to manage the BA list under their own Client).

Distributor and Partner both succeeded cleanly against the same licId=110 branch (each is scoped to the same Admin(104)->Distributor(106)->Partner(109)->Client(110) test hierarchy, confirmed via discover-role-own-client.mjs before running). Grid list 174-658ms, create/update/delete 180-660ms, all create/delete cycles confirmed self-cleaning (BA ids 390, 391 created then deleted). Distributor's create (658ms) is the slowest business call recorded so far — plausibly a cold-start effect, being the first API call issued in this run's process.
runs.note: The Client role was also attempted in this same invocation but hit the login rate limit (5 req/min, per CLAUDE.md) — its login returned 429 and everything downstream was a bogus 401, not real timing data. Discarded; see ba-grid-client-retry below for the valid Client run.

runs.summary: Re-run after waiting out the login rate-limit window. Clean result: login 200, grid list 206-656ms, create/update/delete 212-272ms, BA id 392 created then deleted successfully.
